title: Release approval
passage:
Who can authorize the firmware release?
A. The quality manager has to sign off. B. The release notes are attached. C. It was installed yesterday.
passageZh:
誰可以核准發布這個韌體版本？
A. 必須由品質經理簽核。
B. 版本說明已附上。
C. 它昨天已安裝。
